name: ODRL Offer
abstract: W3C ODRL 2.2 Offer policy stating the access and usage conditions a data provider sets for a digital object: permissions (may do), obligations (must do) and prohibitions (must not do), each with an action, a target asset and optional constraints. A permission duty constrained by event lt policyUsage marks an access condition, to be fulfilled before the object is retrieved. Uses ODRL compact keys under the ODRL JSON-LD context plus the cdifa1 prefix for CDIF Access actions. Draft: the cdifa1 action vocabulary and the ODRL profile it lives in are not yet defined. Uses building blocks: objectReference (cdifDataType).
